messages:
Ravi (partnerships): quick sync  ACME wants an embargoed listing until PR goes live. Marketplace asked for SOC2 exec summary + pen-test exec + evidence bundle. Can we support gated reviewer access instead of full public artifacts?
Ana (security): gated reviewer is fine. We'll produce a redacted bundle for public listing and a gated bucket for marketplace reviewers. Need legal signoff on gated access terms.
Ben (cloud): upload plan: partners/acme/2149999999/ with soc2-redacted.zip, pen-exec.pdf, metadata.json. Gated reviewer links will be presigned with short TTL and logged.
Jules (SI): for the pen witness: propose 90m remote slot. We'll run auth, session key handling, and telemetry leak checks. Need partner to drop CI logs by EOD tomorrow.
Kara (legal): gated reviewer access requires a short access agreement. I can draft a 1-paragraph reviewer clause and time-limited access policy. Also confirm we can't expose customer PII.
Lexi (sales): partner wants to keep listing embargoed until our joint announcement. They'll accept gated review now if we can prove redaction and chain-of-custody. PR target is next Friday.
marketplace-bot: Ingestion reminder: metadata v2 required fields: partner_name, listing_id, artifact_types, evidence_ts, contact_email, checksum_sha256. If gated, include access_policy_url in metadata. See https://marketplace.docs/ingest.
Ana (security): redaction map will include removed fields and justification. We'll also generate attest_security.txt signed by security lead. Kara, will you review redaction map before upload?
Kara (legal): yes, send map at least 4 hours before upload. I'll confirm wording for any redacted control info we must preserve.
Ben (cloud): checksum plan: create sha256 for each artifact and include in metadata.json. Example metadata: {"partner_name":"ACME","listing_id":"acme-gateway","artifact_types":"soc2,pen_exec","evidence_ts":"2149999999","contact_email":"lexi@redwood.ai","checksum_sha256":"<sha256>","access_policy_url":"https://redwood.internal/gated/acme/2149999999"}
Jules (SI): I'll prep the witness runbook and share test vectors. Will also prepare a short "known gaps" doc we can include if partner logs are missing.
Lexi (sales): I'll coordinate partner ops; they'll try to deliver logs by 10:00 PT tomorrow. If they miss, we'll request a short exception from marketplace PM and note it in submission.
Ravi (partnerships): owners: Ana -> redacted bundle & attest, Ben -> upload + presigns + metadata, Jules -> witness runbook, Kara -> legal review of redaction & gated clause, Lexi -> partner comms. ETA: artifacts uploaded to gated bucket by Thu EOD.
marketplace-bot: Note: uploads >50MB require multipart presign. Use aws s3api create-multipart-upload for larger binaries.
Ana (security): will attach redaction checklist (keys, IPs, PII, HSM logs) and initial redaction diff in gated repo today.
Ben (cloud): will automate presign generation and log every access. I'll post presign URLs in this thread once legal signs access policy.
Kara (legal): will draft access agreement and return within 12 hours. If marketplace requires reviewer NDA, we'll use a time-limited reviewer agreement.
Jules (SI): will confirm Tue/Wed witness availability. If partner can't give logs, we'll limit scope and document it.
Lexi (sales): will update partner and marketplace PM. I'll put a hold on PR until we get a go from legal + security.
Ravi (partnerships): thanks all. Please ping here when tasks complete and paste metadata.json (no secrets). We'll send one-line confirmation to marketplace PM once presigns are available. :rocket:
